{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for new customers reached by paid_search
subset = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Confirm the subset is non-empty
assert len(subset) > 0, "No new customers reached by paid_search. Premise failed."

# Confirm converted is binary
assert set(subset['converted'].unique()) == {0, 1}, "'converted' is not binary. Premise failed."

# Compute conversion rate
n_converted = subset['converted'].sum()
n_total = len(subset)
fraction = n_converted / n_total

# Output the result
print(fraction)"}
